package.name: nero_joint_control
package.description:
Joint-space execution for the NERO arm: a validated FollowJointTrajectory action server that streams MoveIt trajectories to agx_arm_ctrl's control/joint_states topic.
This package and impedance_control are mutually exclusive peers -- both are owners of the arm's command path and of the puppet/joint_states feedback topic, so exactly one of them runs at a time. nero_bringup picks; see pick_place.launch.py vs pick_place_impedance.launch.py.
